headline: Dark Magician Girl
title: Dark Magician Girl Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Dark Magician Girl. What is it? It is a Level six DARK Spellcaster with two thousand attack. What does it do? She gains three hundred attack for every Dark Magician or Magician of Black Chaos in the Graveyard. How do you use it? Pair her with a Dark Magician deck so the Graveyard fills up with her master. She is in Duelist Pack: Yugi. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!

scenes.sub: +300 ATK per Dark Magician in GY
